lesson_title: What Is This Building Made Of?
hook_text: Sand becomes windows. Oil becomes light switches. Goats become curtains.
clip_script: A new library in Mahikeng. Concrete pillars: cement, sand, stone and water, rock-hard. A plaster cornice: heated gypsum, poured into a mould. Floor tiles: clay, fired in a kiln. Windows: sand melted into glass. Light switches: plastic, made from oil. Curtains: mohair from Angora goats. Walls: painted to colour and protect. Almost nothing here came out of the ground ready to use.
visual_style: Whiteboard building with each part labelled, then an arrow from each part back to its raw material.
mood: Amazed, like discovering the secret recipe of a building.
pacing: One material per beat, each with its raw material and one property.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list five processed materials in your classroom.
